target.title: fix(cli): read Logger level and mode flags under the serial queue
target.body:
## Summary

`Logger` stores level/mode/buffer flags as `nonisolated(unsafe)` and mutates them under a concurrent queue barrier, but `log`, `startTimer`, and `stopTimer` read those flags **outside** the queue. Concurrent `setVerboseMode` / `setMinimumLogLevel` / `setJsonOutputMode` can race those reads.

This PR snapshots `minimumLogLevel`, `verboseMode`, and `isJsonOutputMode` under `queue.sync` before deciding whether to emit or buffer.

## Failure scenario

1. Thread A calls `setJsonOutputMode(true)` under a barrier.
2. Thread B is mid-`log` and samples `isJsonOutputMode` / `minimumLogLevel` off-queue.
3. B may emit to stderr while JSON mode was requested (or drop/buffer incorrectly).

## Verification

- `swift build --target PeekabooCLI` → complete
- Added `LoggerQueueSafetyTests` concurrent stress test (CI will execute under full Xcode).

## Scope

CLI `Logger` flag reads only.
